snippet.title: Second Soul
snippet.description:
Kept you waiting, huh?

Sonic Essence is back! With 2 new zones, bosses, and all new cutscenes featuring voices from @KoltJolt, @mia.the_artist and @duoge9139! Keep an eye out for us at the Sonic Hacking Contest 2025!
